note: Round 2 confirmed all 3 R1 Major findings resolved; raised 2 follow-on issues from the fixes.

issues.summary: The TempVars extractor still matched inside bracketed identifiers such as [TempVars!fake], so the token-awareness fix was incomplete.
issues.fix: R2: extend the left look-behind to exclude '['. Superseded by the R3 token-aware scanner that skips all bracketed spans.

issues.summary: ParseFormRefPath removed empty '!' segments before validation, so [Forms]!![txtId] could collapse into a fabricated supplier.
issues.fix: R2: keep empty segments and require a Forms/Reports root + non-empty object. Tightened to a strict 2-or-3 segment shape in R3.
